## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated at **all applicable levels**: unit, integration, and end-to-end
- [ ] Tests cover **happy and unhappy paths**, and none hit live external services
- [ ] `ruff check` and `pytest` (all three levels) pass locally
- [ ] OpenSpec change/specs updated (for non-trivial changes) and `tasks.md` reflects reality
- [ ] **Free sources only**: no paid APIs or subscriptions; source terms and rate limits respected
- [ ] README / CONTRIBUTING updated if behaviour or rules changed
